correctness.rationale: Using \(x=\cos^2(k/2)\) and \(y=k^2\), direct symbolic expansion verifies that the published \(j=1,3\) secular bracket factors exactly as \((2(y+1)x-y)(2(y+1)x-1)\), while the \(j=0\) and \(j=2\) residual factors are the two respective factors. This gives the two tangent equations. The two root sets are disjoint, and differentiating their scalar equations proves every positive root simple. Each factor occurs in exactly three symmetry sectors, so the corresponding graph eigenspace has multiplicity three. Standard pole/regular-point expansions give the stated \(\sqrt2/K_n\) and alternating \(L_n^{-2}\) offsets. The assigned verifier and an independent symbolic factorization both reproduce the exact algebra.
